title: Senior HR & Administration Coordinator
description:
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

**1 Training**
**Training Planning:** 
 Coordinate and execute the annual training calendar based on business and employee development needs.
   

  

**Training Needs Identification:** 
 Conduct TNI and coordinate training nominations with respective departments.
   

  

**Training Coordination:** 
 Organise induction, onboarding, technical, behavioural and compliance training programmes.
   

  

**Training Records:** 
 Maintain training records, attendance, feedback and effectiveness data in HR/Learning systems.
   

  

**Training KPIs:** 
 Monitor training KPIs such as training hours, mandays and completion of planned programmes.
   

  

**Skill Matrix:** 
 Coordinate skill development, competency assessments, skill matrix and employee development initiatives.
   

  

* Employee Engagement


**Employee Engagement:** 
 Plan and execute employee engagement activities, events, celebrations and employee connect programmes.
   

  

**Employee Communication:** 
 Coordinate employee communication, recognition and reward initiatives to promote a positive workplace culture.
   

  

**Engagement Surveys:** 
 Support employee engagement surveys, analyse feedback and coordinate implementation of action plans.
   

  

* Recruitment


**Manpower Requisition:** 
 Coordinate manpower requisitions and understand job requirements with hiring managers.
   

  

**Candidate Sourcing:** 
 Source and screen candidates through recruitment agencies, job portals, employee referrals, campus hiring and other channels.
   

  

**Interview Coordination:** 
 Coordinate interviews, candidate assessments, selection processes and timely follow\-up with candidates and hiring managers.
   

  

**Offer \& Joining:** 
 Manage offer, pre\-employment documentation, background verification and joining formalities.
   

  

**Recruitment MIS:** 
 Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor hiring metrics such as Time to Hire, vacancies and offer\-to\-joining ratio.
   

  

**HR Coordination \& Reporting:** 
 Prepare HR MIS and reports and ensure timely coordination with employees, departments, vendors and external agencies.
   

  

* Performance Management coordination


 Yearly objective setting
   

  

 Yearly \& half yearly reviews
   

  

 IDP setting
   

  

 W2HO data updation
   

  

* Attend and comply to the HR audits


 Candidate with 4 years experience with master degree is preferred
   

  

 Join us. Help protect food, people and the planet.

 SIG competencies
   

  

 We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, employees who create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. If you actively seek new ways to grow and be challenged, if you develop people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals, SIG is the place for you. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer\-centric solutions. Finally, we are looking for colleagues who build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Are you someone who applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals? Are you someone who can create new and better ways for the organization to be successful? If the answer is 'yes', come and join us.
   

  

 Our promise

title: Assistant Training Manager for Lonavala
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Assistant Training Manager from the hospitality industry to support the Learning \& Development function. The role will be responsible for coordinating and delivering training programs, ensuring effective onboarding of new employees, and supporting continuous learning and development across departments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Assist in planning, coordinating, and conducting training programs for associates across various departments.
   

  

 Conduct new\-joiner induction and orientation programs.
   

  

 Coordinate departmental training requirements with HODs and managers.
   

  

 Identify training needs and assist in preparing Training Need Analysis (TNA).
   

  

 Conduct sessions on hospitality standards, guest service, grooming, communication, SOPs, and workplace behaviour.
   

  

 Monitor and maintain training attendance, training calendars, records, and MIS.
   

  

 Coordinate on\-the\-job training and departmental skill development programs.
   

  

 Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback and assessments.
   

  

 Support the implementation of L\&D initiatives, employee engagement activities, and development programs.
   

  

 Assist in preparing training materials, presentations, handouts, and assessments.
   

  

 Ensure training documentation and records are maintained accurately.
   

  

 Work closely with HR and departmental HODs to address identified training gaps.
   

  

 Support internal trainers and subject\-matter experts in conducting departmental training.
   

  

 Participate in audits and ensure compliance with company training standards and SOPs.
   

  

**Job Expectations**
 Good knowledge of hospitality operations and service standards.
   

  

 Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Confident in conducting classroom and practical training sessions.
   

  

**Minimum Qualification**
 Graduate / Diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management
   

  

**Minimum Job Experience**
 2–5 years of experience in Training \& Development
   

  

**Reporting To**
 Training Manager
   

  

**Travel**

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
HR \& People Coordinator
 
**RMH Advisors \| Vasai \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site** 



 About the Role
 
 RMH Advisors is looking for a proactive and organised
 **HR \& People Coordinator** 
 to support the day\-to\-day people function of our growing CA firm.
 



 This is an ideal opportunity for a
 **fresher or early\-career HR professional** 
 who wants hands\-on exposure to the complete HR function — recruitment, employee engagement, HR operations, policies, workplace discipline, documentation and people processes.
 



 You will work closely with the HR/People consultant and the firm's leadership team and will play an important role in ensuring that HR processes are actually implemented on the ground.
 



**This is not a purely desk\-based HR administration role.** 




**We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking to employees, following up with people, maintaining discipline, solving small problems independently and taking ownership of getting things done.** 




  





  




 What You Will Do1\. Recruitment \& Hiring
 * Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment for junior and mid\-level positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and other channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate calls.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring managers.
* Maintain the hiring tracker and provide regular updates.
* Coordinate documentation, offer letters and joining formalities.
* Maintain candidate and employee records.
* Follow up with candidates to improve joining ratios.


 2\. HR Operations
 * Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Track attendance, leave and employee movements.
* Support payroll inputs and monthly HR data preparation.
* Maintain HR trackers and MIS.
* Coordinate onboarding and exit formalities.
* Ensure employee files and documentation are complete.
* Follow up on pending HR actions.


 3\. Employee Engagement \& Workplace Culture
 * Support employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate birthday, work anniversary and team activities.
* Help organise employee meetings, workshops and internal events.
* Collect employee feedback and highlight recurring concerns.
* Support initiatives to improve workplace communication and employee experience.


 4\. Workplace Discipline \& Policy Implementation
 
 This is an important part of the role.
 


* Help implement RMH's workplace policies and processes.
* Monitor adherence to workplace expectations.
* Follow up on attendance, punctuality and workplace discipline.
* Address day\-to\-day issues such as mobile usage, AirPods, workplace hygiene, common\-area etiquette and office practices.
* Escalate recurring or sensitive issues to the HR/People consultant or leadership.
* Communicate HR policies clearly to employees.
* Maintain records of policy\-related actions and follow\-ups.


 5\. HR Process \& Documentation
 * Help implement HR processes and systems.
* Maintain HR checklists, trackers and SOPs.
* Support performance review and appraisal processes.
* Coordinate goal\-setting and review documentation.
* Track completion of HR initiatives.
* Help identify gaps in existing people processes and suggest practical improvements.


 6\. HR MIS \& Reporting
 
 Maintain regular reports covering:
 


* Headcount
* Hiring status
* Attendance
* Leave
* Attrition
* Open positions
* Joining status
* Employee documentation
* Performance review status
* HR action items



 The expectation is not just to maintain data, but to
 **spot gaps and flag them proactively.** 



 7\. Founder's Office / People Support
 
 You will work closely with the HR/People consultant and leadership team on people\-related priorities.
 



 This may include:
 


* Following up on action items.
* Coordinating between employees and management.
* Preparing basic reports and presentations.
* Collecting information from different departments.
* Conducting employee check\-ins.
* Helping implement new policies and processes.
* Supporting special HR projects.
* Ensuring that decisions taken by leadership are followed through.



  





  




 What We Are Looking ForMust Have
 * Bachelor's/Master's degree in HR, Management, Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Strong communication skills.
* Good spoken and written English.
* Comfortable speaking to employees at different levels.
* Good organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable using Excel/Google Sheets.
* Willingness to work from the office and be hands\-on.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Positive and professional attitude.


 More Important Than Experience
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Proactive → Observant → Organised → Assertive → Reliable → Curious** 




**You should be someone who sees a problem and thinks:** 



**"Let me find out why this is happening and get it resolved."** 

 rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to do.
 



  





  




 Who Will Do Well in This Role?
 
 Someone who enjoys:
 


* Talking to people
* Organising things
* Following up
* Solving problems
* Creating structure
* Working with Excel/Google Sheets
* Taking ownership
* Learning different areas of HR
* Working closely with leadership



 Someone who wants to learn
 **real\-world HR beyond recruitment and payroll** 
 will get significant exposure in this role.
 



  





  




 What This Role Is NOT
 
 This is not a role where you will:
 


* Only screen resumes
* Only maintain attendance
* Only process payroll
* Only organise employee events
* Wait for instructions for every task



 You will be expected to
 **take ownership of assigned HR processes and follow them through to completion.** 




  





  




 Key Performance Areas
 
 Your performance will be evaluated across:
 


 Recruitment
 * Hiring turnaround time
* Candidate quality
* Joining conversion
* Hiring tracker accuracy


 HR Operations
 * Accuracy of HR records
* Timely completion of HR processes
* Payroll/attendance input accuracy
* Documentation completeness


 Employee Experience
 * Responsiveness to employee queries
* Engagement initiatives
* Employee communication


 Workplace Discipline
 * Timely follow\-up on workplace issues
* Policy awareness and implementation
* Closure of recurring issues


 HR Process
 * Tracker and MIS accuracy
* Timely completion of HR initiatives
* Process adherence
* Proactive identification of gaps


 Ownership
 * Ability to work independently
* Follow\-through on tasks
* Quality and timeliness of reporting
* Ability to escalate issues appropriately



  





  




 Growth Opportunity
 
 This role is designed for someone who wants to build a career in
 **HR Generalist / HRBP / People Operations** 
 .
 



 As you grow, you will get exposure to:
 



**Recruitment → HR Operations → Employee Relations → Performance Management → Policies → Compliance → Employee Engagement → HR Analytics → People Strategy** 




**You will work closely with the HR/People consultant and leadership, giving you exposure to how HR decisions are made in a growing professional\-services organisation.** 



 Location
 
 Vasai
 


 Work Mode
 
 On\-site
 


 Employment Type
 
 Full\-time
 


 Experience
 
 0–2 years
 


 Education
 * Graduate/Postgraduate in HR or a related field

title: Head of HR Management India
description:
**Join DRÄXLMAIER Group and Shape the Future of People Management in India** 




  





 At DRÄXLMAIER Group, we create premium automotive solutions for leading vehicle manufacturers worldwide. Our people are at the heart of our success, and we are looking for a strategic and business\-oriented
 **Head of HR Management** 
 to lead our HR function in India.
 



  





 This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced HR leader to partner with business leaders, drive organizational effectiveness, develop talent, and build a high\-performance culture in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
 



  





**Your Mission**




 As Head of HR Management, you will be responsible for leading the full spectrum of Human Resources activities at our India operation while serving as a trusted advisor to the management team.
 



  





 You will shape and execute the local HR strategy in alignment with business objectives, ensuring that our people, culture, and organizational capabilities support sustainable growth and operational excellence.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Strategic HR Leadership** 



* Develop and execute the site's HR strategy aligned with business priorities.
* Partner closely with plant leadership and HR Asia on workforce and succession planning.
* Provide strategic guidance on organizational development and talent management.
* Drive HR initiatives that enhance business performance and employee engagement.



  





**People \& Talent Management** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, compensation, performance management, development, and succession planning.
* Build leadership capability and organizational effectiveness across the site.
* Oversee training and people development initiatives to meet current and future business needs.



  





**Employee Relations \& Compliance** 



* Serve as the key advisor on employment legislation, labor relations, and HR policies.
* Maintain productive relationships with employee representatives and external stakeholders.
* Ensure full compliance with local labor laws and company policies.
* Support organizational changes, restructuring, and workforce transformation initiatives when required.



  





**HR Operations Excellence** 



* Lead and develop the local HR team.
* Manage HR budgets and workforce planning.
* Monitor and report HR KPIs and workforce analytics.
* Drive continuous improvement of HR processes and employee experience.



  





  





**What You Bring**



* Master's Degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum
 **10 years of progressive HR experience** 
 , including leadership roles.
* Proven experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or multinational environments.
* Strong background across the full HR spectrum, including talent management, employee relations, organizational development, and labor law.
* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Deep understanding of Indian labor legislation and HR best practices.
* Proficiency in English; additional language skills are an advantage.
* Experience with SAP HR and Microsoft Office is preferred.



  





**Ready to Make an Impact?** 




 If you are a passionate HR leader who enjoys driving business success through people, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Apply now and become part of a global team shaping the future of mobility.**

title: Training & Development Manager
description:
TRAINING \& DEVELOPMENT MANAGER
   

  

 Foundry Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Position:** 
 Training \& Development Manager
   

  

**Department:** 
 Human Resources / Training \& Development
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years, preferably in Foundry / Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM – HR / Training \& Development / MSW / Relevant Engineering Qualification
   

  

**Location:** 
 Wai Dist\-Satara Maharashtra
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and implement the annual Training \& Development plan based on organizational and departmental requirements.
* Identify Training Needs (TNI/TNA) based on competency gaps, performance, KRA and skill requirements.
* Develop and maintain skill matrix and competency matrices for employees, operators and technicians.
* Design training programs for new employees, existing employees, contract workers and temporary workers.
* Develop skill\-based training modules for Foundry operations such as:
+ Melting \& Furnace Operations
+ Moulding
+ Core Shop
+ Sand Plant
+ Fettling \& Shot Blasting
+ Quality \& Laboratory
+ Maintenance
+ Crane \& Material Handling
+ Gatecutting/Patternshop
+ Safety and Emergency Response

* Establish and monitor OJT, classroom and practical training programs.
* Develop training materials, SOP\-based training modules, work instructions and evaluation questionnaires.
* Conduct skill\-level assessments and competency evaluations for employees.
* Monitor effectiveness of training through post\-training evaluation, skill improvement and workplace performance.
* Maintain complete training records, attendance, assessment results and competency certification.
* Develop and implement L1/L2/L3/L4 skill certification systems as applicable.
* Coordinate with HODs and Section In\-Charges to identify critical skill gaps and improvement areas.
* Promote Kaizen, suggestion schemes, cross\-functional learning and continuous improvement.
* Monitor training KPIs and prepare monthly / quarterly Training MIS reports.
* Support new employee induction and job\-specific orientation programs.
* Ensure training compliance related to quality, safety, environment and customer requirements.
* Support internal / customer audits related to competency and training records.
* Develop internal trainers through a Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) program.


**Required Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Training Need Identification, Competency Development and Skill Matrix Management.
* Experience in shop\-floor training and operator skill development.
* Good understanding of foundry manufacturing processes will be preferred.
* Knowledge of KRA, KPI, competency assessment and performance management.
* Good presentation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, leadership and people\-management skills.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Quality and Safety systems will be an advantage.


 Key Performance Areas
   

  

**Training Effectiveness \| Competency Development \| Skill Matrix \| Training Compliance \| Employee Development \| New Employee Training \| OJT Effectiveness \| Skill Certification \| Training MIS \| Continuous Improvement**
**Preferred Candidate**
 Candidates with experience in
 **Foundry / Automotive / Engineering / Manufacturing Industries** 
 , particularly in
 **shop\-floor skill development and technical training** 
 , will be preferred.
   

  

**Additional Benefits:** 
 PF / Mediclaim / Leave Payment
   

  

**Facility:** 
 Accommodation provided free of cost
   

  

 subsidiary Canteen /Transport facility
